messages:
deploybot: START rollout prod v3.4.1 -> commit: 8f3a2b9
env: production | regions: us, eu, apac | change_window: 2026-03-20 02:00-04:00 UTC | wave: 4

olivia: ack. I'll monitor EU canaries and coordinate with tim-oncall.

samir: oncall @tim-oncall - please watch infra logs and error spikes. keep canary at 5% for 20m.

deploybot: CANARY_COMPLETE region=us status=healthy latency_p50=72ms errors=0.2% canary_size=3

lee: US metrics look clean, no memory or cpu anomalies. :thumbsup:

maya: starting EU canary now; pinning 4 hosts to v3.4.1 for initial probe.

deploybot: PROGRESS region=eu status=degraded errors=1.8% cause="kvcache-miss spike" auto-threshold=1.0% triggered

olivia: pausing EU rollout. sounds like kv cache eviction change. rolling back EU to v3.4.0. Samir please bisect the cache patch.

samir: running bisect on patch set. quick context: patch #1427 changed kv cache eviction order and TTL handling.

roll command (ops runbook):
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --region eu --tag v3.4.0 --reason "kvcache-miss spike"
```

deploybot: ROLLBACK initiated region=eu target_tag=v3.4.0 initiated_by=olivia

tim-oncall: holding APAC until EU settles. will watch for correlated errors in edge proxies.

deploybot: ROLLBACK_COMPLETE region=eu status=success latency_p50=68ms errors=0.15%

olivia: EU back to v3.4.0. we'll pin EU routing to v3.4.0 until revert PR is merged. applied ops playbook step 3 (pin + notify customers).

samir: PR to revert #1427 opened: https://git.redwood.ai/repo/pull/289 (attached test logs and perf diffs)

lee: APAC canary resumed after EU rollback confirmation, now at 4 hosts. metrics nominal so far.

deploybot: REGIONAL_ROLLOUT_COMPLETE regions=[us,eu,apac] overall_status=healthy note="EU rollback then resumed; APAC and US healthy" commit=8f3a2b9

olivia: drafting release notes and customer-facing blurb. follow-up: postmortem on kv cache policy + improved canary thresholds.

maya: will add more eviction tracing logs to the next canary build. :memo:

tim-oncall: leaving an incident stub in #incidents for tracking and timeline (will transfer to postmortem after PR).

olivia: thanks all. closing wave 4 for now. schedule patch roll-forward once revert PR merges and green CI. :shipit:
